pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions; pyramiding is only authorized after initial position achieves +$10 in floating profit with a trailing breakeven stop.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandate an ATR-based minimum stop-loss distance of at least $1.50 on XAUUSD to prevent normal market noise from triggering premature stop-outs.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively scale out or trail stops dynamically once floating profit reaches +$15.00 to capture extended runs up to +$30.00.
